test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following wrote ‘India Wins freedom’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abul Kalam Azad.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **‘India Wins freedom’ is a book written by Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, who remained Congress President for almost 6 yrs (1940 - 46).**
 
• This was a critical 2nd world war period and very crucial from the Indian freedom movement perspective.
 
• During this period he was in key decision-making and negotiating role with Britishers.
 
• **India Wins Freedom is an enlightening account of the partition from the author, Maulana Azad's perspective.**
 
• It** includes his personal experiences when India became independent **and his ideas on freedom and liberty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru**

 
 
• Nehru was a principal leader of the Indian nationalist movement in the 1930s and 1940s.
 
• He was the first prime minister of Independent India, and he served as the country's prime minister for 17 years.
 
• **Famous Books:**
 
 
• The Discovery of India
 
• Letters from a Father to his Daughter
 
• Glimpses of World History
 
• The Essential Writings, Vol 2
 
• The Unity of India Collected Writings 1937-1940 
 
 
 
 
 
• **Jaswant Singh​**
 
 
• ​Major Jaswant Singh was an officer of the Indian Army and an Indian Cabinet Minister.
 
• **He was one of the founding members of the Bharatiya Janata Party, and was one of India's longest-serving parliamentarians, having been a member of the Lok Sabha or the Rajya Sabha almost continuously between 1980 and 2014.**
 
 
 
• **Rajendra Prasad​**
 
 
• ​Rajendra Prasad was an Indian independence activist, lawyer, and scholar.
 
• **The first president of India was in office from 1950 to 1962.**
 
• He joined the Indian National Congress during the Indian Independence Movement and became a major leader in the region of Bihar and Maharashtra.
 
 

93:T17
